resources.string: Isse Baby: (1) aapke bole hue WhatsApp message khud Send karti hai, (2) khuli hui chat me "isko message karo" bolne par likh kar bhejti hai, (3) background me kisi bhi app ke upar se apps/camera khol paati hai, aur (4) camera ke paas chamakti light dikhati hai. Screen ka koi data kahin bheja nahi jaata.
